notes: Establishes a Kairo-owned Marketing Lab, Skill Registry foundation and deterministic benchmark policy for comparing native and external marketing capabilities.
Corey Haines marketingskills is pinned as an evaluation/reference challenger only; no arbitrary external skill execution, network access, secrets or production Brand selection is enabled in VS-14.
Carousel and Reel strategy become first-class benchmark artifact shapes, but Instagram carousel/Reel publishing, OAuth, Insights and media rendering remain separate future slices.
Truth/Claims, Brand isolation, human approval, publishing authority and metric provenance remain non-replaceable Kairo controls.

approvals.rationale: Approved planning and implementation of the Kairo Marketing Lab: Kairo Native vs Corey Skills vs future skills through a benchmark harness, Skill Registry and Brand-specific evidence-based winner selection, with Reels and carousels treated as benchmark formats.

The approved TRD and Skills Architecture already require external skills to be pinned, provenance/permission reviewed, benchmarked and explicitly promoted. VS-14 implements that existing policy and narrows Corey to reference-only evaluation.

Authorized runtime-enabled implementation of the benchmark/registry foundation under PES/Loop + Superpowers/TDD. External arbitrary skill execution, live skill promotion, social publishing changes and production enablement are excluded.
Exact-SHA human certification remains required after benchmark foundation implementation and deterministic gates pass.
VS-14 does not authorize release or deployment.
VS-14 does not authorize production enablement or automatic Brand skill switching.
